name: The Lantern Hatyai Hotel
detail: The accommodation is very convenient, with easy transportation around and a pleasant walking experience. The room is kept very clean and tidy, providing a quiet and comfortable sleeping environment. The amenities are complete, and the staff are friendly and attentive. The overall value for money is extremely high, and I highly recommend it. The WiFi is stable and meets daily needs, making it a very enjoyable stay.

name: The Smart Hotel Hat Yai
detail: The room is very beautiful and also very clean, the staff provides excellent service, speaks sweetly, and is cheerful. Behind the room, there is a balcony to enjoy the natural view; the atmosphere is really nice. At the entrance of the alley, there is a 7-Eleven, and across the street is Central Plaza, so you can easily walk across the road to the mall. It's very convenient.

name: CC Hotel Hatyai
detail: Overall, the stay these past two days has been quite good. First, the room is nice, deserving a perfect score of 💯; it’s clean, tidy, and beautiful. All the room facilities are functional, the air conditioning is sufficient, and the water heater provides enough hot water. The staff are friendly, attentive, enthusiastic, and reassuring. The environment is just slightly lacking; the location is relatively convenient, but it can be a bit noisy (poor sound insulation). However, overall it is good! Worth staying!

name: Centara Hotel Hat Yai
detail: Centara Hotel Hat Yai was very impressive in terms of location, cleanliness, and service. It is a hotel that meets the needs of both tourism and relaxation. Highlights 🏨 Excellent location in the heart of Hat Yai, next to Central Festival Hat Yai, within easy walking distance to Kim Yong Market, night market, restaurants, and convenience stores. 🛏️ Spacious and clean rooms with soft beds for a comfortable sleep. ❄️ Refreshingly cool air conditioning for a full relaxation experience. 🚿 Spacious and clean bathrooms with complete amenities. 👨‍💼 Friendly staff with quick check-in and check-out. 🏊 Comprehensive facilities including a swimming pool, fitness center, and restaurant. 🚗 Convenient and sufficient parking available. Summary It is a hotel that offers great value for the price, in terms of location, cleanliness, and service. It is suitable for both tourists and business travelers. If I have the opportunity to come back to Hat Yai, I will definitely stay here again. ⭐ Rating: 5/5 Recommended for those looking for quality accommodation in the heart of Hat Yai.

name: Hub Hostel Hatyai
detail: Clean accommodation at an affordable price. Drinking water, thick and soft clean towels, a clean bathroom, and lockers are provided. -Both the entrance and exit areas are clean, and the main entrance uses a Key Tag system for security. -The downstairs staff are very friendly, smiling, and helpful. Clean, thick, and soft bed Clean blanket, curtains, and pillows -Clean floors -Hot shower available -Clean toilet (There might be some loud music from outside in the early evening, which is normal for the city center, but it gets quiet late at night.) *Location: Very close to Hat Yai Railway Station, about a 7–10 minute walk. **Overall, it is great value for money, especially for backpackers. I really liked it and will definitely stay here again next time I visit Hat Yai.

name: Hatyai Hour Hotel
detail: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ This stay experience was very satisfactory! The hotel environment was clean and comfortable, and the room was tidy and beautiful, especially the bed, which was really very comfortable to sleep on! The mattress was of moderate softness, and the pillows were also very comfortable, allowing for a good night's sleep until dawn, with great sleep quality! 😍 The staff were friendly and had a great service attitude. Overall, the stay experience was very pleasant, and I will definitely return next time! ❤️ The boss even personally provided service and gave a small gift. 👍🏻
